description: This file defines a PHP trait 'AttendanceRecordPermissionTrait' used within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for managing permissions related to AttendanceRecord entities. The trait includes a method to check if an attendance record is accessible based on user roles and employee data, and enforces that it is used within classes that extend 'Endpoint'.

methods.name: checkAttendanceRecordAccessible
methods.description: Checks whether a given AttendanceRecord is accessible based on user roles. Throws ForbiddenException if access is denied, or LogicException if used outside an Endpoint context.
